string-array.name: auto_paste_features
string-array.item: Automatically pastes AI-generated text into the focused field
Works in most apps with editable text fields

string-array.name: auto_paste_data_usage
string-array.item: Processes your text locally for paste actions
Does not collect personal data

string-array.name: auto_paste_activation_steps
string-array.item: Open system Accessibility settings
Enable TapScribe Accessibility service

string-array.name: auto_prompt_intro_points
string-array.item: Automatically selects a prompt based on your usage
Can speed up your workflow

string-array.name: auto_prompt_setup_steps
string-array.item: Create or choose your favorite prompts
Enable auto-prompt in settings when desired

string-array.name: auto_prompt_use_cases
string-array.item: Emails and messages
Summaries and notes

string-array.name: auto_prompt_change_steps
string-array.item: Open settings and switch the selected prompt

string-array.name: openai_overview_points
string-array.item: Realtime transcription over WebSocket with gpt-realtime-whisper
Streams audio chunks and transcript deltas while you speak

string-array.name: openai_cost_points
string-array.item: Priced by audio duration, not text tokens
Current price is about $0.017 per audio minute
Long recordings cost more, so stop when you are done speaking

string-array.name: openai_advantage_points
string-array.item: Server-side VAD and partial transcripts
Lower waiting time after pressing stop than file-based transcription

string-array.name: openai_requirement_points
string-array.item: Requires an OpenAI API key

string-array.name: welcome_gemini_steps
string-array.item: Get a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
Paste the key in settings

string-array.name: welcome_permissions_steps
string-array.item: Grant microphone permission
Allow notifications (optional)

string-array.name: welcome_auto_paste_steps
string-array.item: Enable Accessibility service for auto-paste (optional)

string-array.name: welcome_ready_steps
string-array.item: Start the mic bubble and try a prompt
